searchText: Prototype here: https://github.com/protolambda/eth2-api-testgen Idea is that you write tiny generator functions that yield some URL/inputs/status data, which then get organized and executed against a real eth2 beacon node. Client implementers could use it to hit every v1 API endpoint as test. With some more scripting, you could compare the outputs. And I'll use the outputs as test vectors for the API bindings I'm working on
